answer: Make vouching carry liability. A new account counts only after 3 veterans each vouch for it by locking 15 tokens against it for 20 epochs. If the account is later proven sybil, all 45 tokens are slashed and each voucher's vote weight is halved. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 3,000 vouches and 45,000 tokens at risk, and veterans won't stake on strangers. Vouchers learn to read the delta between a newcomer and a puppet with falcon eyes, since one bad signature shatters like crystal.
